advancements.solomod.broken_seal.descrip: Ages ago, the five Monarchs united against something greater than all of them. Now that they have fallen... nothing holds it back.
advancements.solomod.broken_seal.title: The Broken Seal
advancements.solomod.defeat_all_monarchs: Defeat the five Monarchs and master every element.
Cut through the gales and dethrone the Emperor of the Skies, storm lord reigning over unreachable heights.
advancements.solomod.defeat_monarch_eart: Shatter the amber heart of the Ancient Titan, the colossal tree whose ancient roots bore the weight of the world.
advancements.solomod.defeat_monarch_fire: Extinguish the blazing fury of the Volcanic King, the magma monarch who turns continents into searing cauldrons.
advancements.solomod.defeat_monarch_none: Topple the Colossus King, a primordial stone monarch whose raw might defies all elemental forces.
advancements.solomod.defeat_monarch_wate: Subjugate the Crowned Leviathan, the kraken king of oceanic trenches whose tidal waves swallow whole empires.
advancements.solomod.defeat_sovereign.de: Defeat the Sovereign, who claimed the power of the five Monarchs for himself.
advancements.solomod.root.description: Awaken Mastery, forge elemental weapons, and challenge the Monarchs of this world.
advancements.solomod.root.title: Solo Mod

credits.solomod.epilogue.3: You finished what the Monarchs started.

talent_description.solomod.crescent: A wide forward slash, hitting each enemy once.
talent_description.solomod.dash_strike: Advanced skill: dash through enemies. Use Shift + right click.
talent_description.solomod.elemental_bur: Learned ultimate: a neutral area blast. Replaces the advanced skill on Shift + right click.
talent_description.solomod.ground_slam: Advanced skill: area impact and knockback. Use Shift + right click.
talent_description.solomod.hammer_leap: Jump, or dive while airborne. Falling increases impact, up to 24 blocks.
talent_description.solomod.hammer_quake: A ground wave that stops at walls, liquids and ledges.
talent_description.solomod.hammer_sweep: A grounded spin dealing circular damage and knockback.
talent_description.solomod.leap: Legacy axe leap followed by a ground impact.
talent_description.solomod.mana_bolt: Advanced skill: a magic shot that scales with INT.
talent_description.solomod.rapier_dash: Hold right click and release: more charge means a longer dash.
talent_description.solomod.rapier_flurry: Three quick thrusts in a forward cone.
talent_description.solomod.rising: An upward slash that lifts the target.
talent_description.solomod.teleport: With the dagger thrown, Shift + right click teleports and retrieves it. Unsafe destinations cost no mana.
talent_description.solomod.throw: Throw the dagger. Right click recalls it without spending mana.
tooltip.solomod.class_ability.axe: Right-click: leap and smash the ground for an area critical
tooltip.solomod.class_ability.dagger: Right-click: throw or recall; Shift + click while thrown: golden lightning teleport
tooltip.solomod.class_ability.hammer: R cycles Crushing Leap, Demolition Spin and Seismic Rupture; right-click uses them. The leap works in midair
tooltip.solomod.class_ability.longsword: R cycles Crescent, Rising and Cross Slash; right-click performs the technique with 3D light blades
tooltip.solomod.class_ability.rapier: R cycles techniques; right-click uses them. Hold and release Lightning Thrust to charge its distance
tooltip.solomod.skill_hint_after_recall: Recover the dagger before using its tier skill with Shift + right-click
